units.leftText: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
units.rightText: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
units.rightText: to whom the word of Jehovah came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
leftNotes: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
units.rightText: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

units.leftText: Now the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Now the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you.
units.rightText: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee, and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee; I have appointed thee a prophet unto the nations.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
units.rightText: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! behold, I know not how to speak; for I am a child.
leftNotes: 1:6 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

units.leftText: But the LORD said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
units.rightText: But Jehovah said unto me, Say not, I am a child; for to whomsoever I shall send thee thou shalt go, and whatsoever I shall command thee thou shalt speak.

units.leftText: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: Be not afraid because of them; for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: Then the LORD stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then the LORD said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
units.rightText: Then Jehovah put forth his hand, and touched my mouth; and Jehovah said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth:

units.leftText: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
units.rightText: see, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?”
units.rightText: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond-tree.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”
units.rightText: Then said Jehovah unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I watch over my word to perform it.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?”
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a boiling caldron; and the face thereof is from the north.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to me, “Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
units.rightText: Then Jehovah said unto me, Out of the north evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

units.leftText: For behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith Jehovah; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

units.leftText: I will utter my judgments against them concerning all their wickedness,
units.rightText: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

units.leftText: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.
units.rightText: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at them, lest I dismay thee before them.

units.leftText: For behold, I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
units.rightText: For, behold, I have made thee this day a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and brazen walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

units.leftText: They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you”, says the LORD, “to rescue you.”
units.rightText: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee, saith Jehovah, to deliver thee.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says,
units.rightText: Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith Jehovah, I remember for thee the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals; how thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

units.leftText: Israel was holiness to the LORD,
units.rightText: Israel was holiness unto Jehovah, the first-fruits of his increase: all that devour him shall be held guilty; evil shall come upon them, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: Hear the LORD’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!
units.rightText: Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

units.leftText: The LORD says,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

units.leftText: They didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up out of the land of Egypt,
units.rightText: Neither said they, Where is Jehovah that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that none passed through, and where no man dwelt?

units.leftText: I brought you into a plentiful land
units.rightText: And I brought you into a plentiful land, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

units.leftText: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is the LORD?’
units.rightText: The priests said not, Where is Jehovah? and they that handle the law knew me not: the rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

units.leftText: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says the LORD,
units.rightText: Wherefore I will yet contend with you, saith Jehovah, and with your children’s children will I contend.

units.leftText: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see.
units.rightText: For pass over to the isles of Kittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently; and see if there hath been such a thing.

units.leftText: Has a nation changed its gods,
units.rightText: Hath a nation changed its gods, which yet are no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

units.leftText: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this
units.rightText: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “For my people have committed two evils:
units.rightText: For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

units.leftText: Is Israel a slave?
units.rightText: Is Israel a servant? is he a home-born slave? why is he become a prey?

units.leftText: The young lions have roared at him and raised their voices.
units.rightText: The young lions have roared upon him, and yelled; and they have made his land waste: his cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

units.leftText: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.
units.rightText: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head.

units.leftText: “Haven’t you brought this on yourself,
units.rightText: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken Jehovah thy God, when he led thee by the way?

units.leftText: Now what do you gain by going to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor?
units.rightText: And now what hast thou to do in the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? or what hast thou to do in the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

units.leftText: “Your own wickedness will correct you,
units.rightText: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and a bitter, that thou hast forsaken Jehovah thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: “For long ago I broke off your yoke,
units.rightText: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bonds; and thou saidst, I will not serve; for upon every high hill and under every green tree thou didst bow thyself, playing the harlot.

units.leftText: Yet I had planted you a noble vine,
units.rightText: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine unto me?

units.leftText: For though you wash yourself with lye,
units.rightText: For though thou wash thee with lye, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord Jehovah.

units.leftText: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled.
units.rightText: How canst thou say, I am not defiled, I have not gone after the Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

units.leftText: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving.
units.rightText: a wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind in her desire; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

units.leftText: “Keep your feet from being bare,
units.rightText: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst. But thou saidst, It is in vain; no, for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

units.leftText: As the thief is ashamed when he is found,
units.rightText: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets;

units.leftText: who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’
units.rightText: who say to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

units.leftText: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves?
units.rightText: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

units.leftText: “Why will you contend with me?
units.rightText: Wherefore will ye contend with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I have struck your children in vain.
units.rightText: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

units.leftText: Generation, consider the LORD’s word.
units.rightText: O generation, see ye the word of Jehovah. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? or a land of thick darkness? wherefore say my people, We are broken loose; we will come no more unto thee?

units.leftText: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments,
units.rightText: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

units.leftText: How well you prepare your way to seek love!
units.rightText: How trimmest thou thy way to seek love! therefore even the wicked women hast thou taught thy ways.

units.leftText: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts.
units.rightText: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the innocent poor: thou didst not find them breaking in; but it is because of all these things.

units.leftText: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent.
units.rightText: Yet thou saidst, I am innocent; surely his anger is turned away from me. Behold, I will enter into judgment with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

units.leftText: Why do you go about so much to change your ways?
units.rightText: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou shalt be ashamed of Egypt also, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

units.leftText: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head;
units.rightText: From thence also shalt thou go forth, with thy hands upon thy head: for Jehovah hath rejected those in whom thou trustest, and thou shalt not prosper with them.

units.leftText: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, will he return unto her again? will not that land be greatly polluted? But thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.
units.rightText: Lift up thine eyes unto the bare heights, and see; where hast thou not been lain with? By the ways hast thou sat for them, as an Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

units.leftText: Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead and you refused to be ashamed.
units.rightText: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; yet thou hadst a harlot’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

units.leftText: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth!’?
units.rightText: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My Father, thou art the guide of my youth?

units.leftText: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”
units.rightText: Will he retain his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and hast done evil things, and hast had thy way.

units.leftText: Moreover, the LORD said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and has played the prostitute there.
units.rightText: Moreover Jehovah said unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

units.leftText: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return, and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
units.rightText: And I said after she had done all these things, She will return unto me; but she returned not: and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

units.leftText: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear, but she also went and played the prostitute.
units.rightText: And I saw, when, for this very cause that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorcement, yet treacherous Judah her sister feared not; but she also went and played the harlot.

units.leftText: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.
units.rightText: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

units.leftText: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not returned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Backsliding Israel hath showed herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

units.leftText: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says the LORD; ‘I will not look in anger on you, for I am merciful,’ says the LORD. ‘I will not keep anger forever.
units.rightText: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith Jehovah; I will not look in anger upon you; for I am merciful, saith Jehovah, I will not keep anger for ever.

units.leftText: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against the LORD your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’” says the LORD.
units.rightText: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against Jehovah thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Return, backsliding children,” says the LORD, “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.
units.rightText: Return, O backsliding children, saith Jehovah; for I am a husband unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

units.leftText: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
units.rightText: And I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

units.leftText: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land in those days,” says the LORD, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of the LORD’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when ye are multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith Jehovah, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of Jehovah; neither shall it come to mind; neither shall they remember it; neither shall they miss it; neither shall it be made any more.

units.leftText: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘The LORD’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to the LORD’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
units.rightText: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of Jehovah; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of Jehovah, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

units.leftText: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.
units.rightText: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance unto your fathers.

units.leftText: “But I said, ‘How I desire to put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father”, and shall not turn away from following me.’
units.rightText: But I said, How I will put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of the nations! and I said, Ye shall call me My Father, and shall not turn away from following me.

units.leftText: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten the LORD their God.
units.rightText: A voice is heard upon the bare heights, the weeping and the supplications of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Jehovah their God.

units.leftText: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding.
units.rightText: Return, ye backsliding children, I will heal your backslidings.

units.leftText: Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
units.rightText: Truly in vain is the help that is looked for from the hills, the tumult on the mountains: truly in Jehovah our God is the salvation of Israel.

units.leftText: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
units.rightText: But the shameful thing hath devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

units.leftText: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed the LORD our God’s voice.”
units.rightText: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Jehovah our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day; and we have not obeyed the voice of Jehovah our God.

units.leftText: “If you will return, Israel,” says the LORD, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;
units.rightText: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith Jehovah, if thou wilt return unto me, and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight; then shalt thou not be removed;

units.leftText: and you will swear, ‘As the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”
units.rightText: and thou shalt swear, As Jehovah liveth, in truth, in justice, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

units.leftText: For the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

units.leftText: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go out like fire, and burn so that no one can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
units.rightText: Circumcise yourselves to Jehovah, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

units.leftText: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let’s go into the fortified cities!’
units.rightText: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry aloud and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the fortified cities.

units.leftText: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”
units.rightText: Set up a standard toward Zion: flee for safety, stay not; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

units.leftText: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way. He has gone out from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.
units.rightText: A lion is gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations; he is on his way, he is gone forth from his place, to make thy land desolate, that thy cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

units.leftText: For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of the LORD hasn’t turned back from us.
units.rightText: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Jehovah is not turned back from us.

units.leftText: “It will happen at that day,” says the LORD, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the princes. The priests will be astonished, and the prophets will wonder.”
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith Jehovah, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”
units.rightText: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the life.

units.leftText: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind blows from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse.
units.rightText: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse;

units.leftText: A full wind from these will come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”
units.rightText: a full wind from these shall come for me: now will I also utter judgments against them.

units.leftText: Behold, he will come up as clouds, and his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.
units.rightText: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as the whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are ruined.

units.leftText: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
units.rightText: O Jerusalem, wash thy heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thine evil thoughts lodge within thee?

units.leftText: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:
units.rightText: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth evil from the hills of Ephraim.

units.leftText: “Tell the nations, behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.
units.rightText: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

units.leftText: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says the LORD.
units.rightText: As keepers of a field are they against her round about, because she hath been rebellious against me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness, for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”
units.rightText: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness; for it is bitter, for it reacheth unto thy heart.

units.leftText: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart! My heart trembles within me. I can’t hold my peace, because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
units.rightText: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart; my heart is disquieted in me; I cannot hold my peace; because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

units.leftText: Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.
units.rightText: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is laid waste: suddenly are my tents destroyed, and my curtains in a moment.

units.leftText: How long will I see the standard and hear the sound of the trumpet?
units.rightText: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

units.leftText: “For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but they don’t know how to do good.”
units.rightText: For my people are foolish, they know me not; they are sottish children, and they have no understanding; they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

units.leftText: I saw the earth and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
units.rightText: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was waste and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

units.leftText: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.
units.rightText: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved to and fro.

units.leftText: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.
units.rightText: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

units.leftText: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of the LORD, before his fierce anger.
units.rightText: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of Jehovah, and before his fierce anger.

units.leftText: For the LORD says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah, The whole land shall be a desolation; yet will I not make a full end.

units.leftText: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”
units.rightText: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black; because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.

units.leftText: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers. They go into the thickets and climb up on the rocks. Every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.
units.rightText: Every city fleeth for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they go into the thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city is forsaken, and not a man dwelleth therein.

units.leftText: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck yourself with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with makeup, you make yourself beautiful in vain. Your lovers despise you. They seek your life.
units.rightText: And thou, when thou art made desolate, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with scarlet, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou enlargest thine eyes with paint, in vain dost thou make thyself fair; thy lovers despise thee, they seek thy life.

units.leftText: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who gives birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”
units.rightText: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that gaspeth for breath, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul fainteth before the murderers.

units.leftText: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.
units.rightText: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that doeth justly, that seeketh truth; and I will pardon her.

units.leftText: Though they say, ‘As the LORD lives,’ surely they swear falsely.”
units.rightText: And though they say, As Jehovah liveth; surely they swear falsely.

units.leftText: O LORD, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, do not thine eyes look upon truth? thou hast stricken them, but they were not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the LORD’s way, nor the law of their God.
units.rightText: Then I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish; for they know not the way of Jehovah, nor the law of their God:

units.leftText: I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of the LORD, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
units.rightText: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they know the way of Jehovah, and the law of their God. But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

units.leftText: Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
units.rightText: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, a wolf of the evenings shall destroy them, a leopard shall watch against their cities; every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces; because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.

units.leftText: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.
units.rightText: How can I pardon thee? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the harlots’ houses;

units.leftText: They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
units.rightText: they were as fed horses roaming at large; every one neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

units.leftText: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
units.rightText: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

units.leftText: “Go up on her walls, and destroy, but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches, for they are not the LORD’s.
units.rightText: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her branches; for they are not Jehovah’s.

units.leftText: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: They have denied the LORD, and said, “It is not he. Evil won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.
units.rightText: They have denied Jehovah, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

units.leftText: The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”
units.rightText: and the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it will devour them.
units.rightText: Wherefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

units.leftText: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far away, house of Israel,” says the LORD. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know and don’t understand what they say.
units.rightText: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

units.leftText: Their quiver is an open tomb. They are all mighty men.
units.rightText: Their quiver is an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

units.leftText: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.
units.rightText: And they shall eat up thy harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat; they shall eat up thy flocks and thy herds; they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig-trees; they shall beat down thy fortified cities, wherein thou trustest, with the sword.

units.leftText: “But even in those days,” says the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.
units.rightText: But even in those days, saith Jehovah, I will not make a full end with you.

units.leftText: It will happen when you say, ‘Why has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just as you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your land, so you will serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore hath Jehovah our God done all these things unto us? then shalt thou say unto them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served foreign gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

units.leftText: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
units.rightText: Declare ye this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

units.leftText: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
units.rightText: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; that have eyes, and see not; that have ears, and hear not:

units.leftText: Don’t you fear me?’ says the LORD; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’
units.rightText: Fear ye not me? saith Jehovah: will ye not tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea, by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it? and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it.

units.leftText: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart. They have revolted and gone.
units.rightText: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

units.leftText: They don’t say in their heart, ‘Let’s now fear the LORD our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season, who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’
units.rightText: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear Jehovah our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in its season; that preserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

units.leftText: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.
units.rightText: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good from you.

units.leftText: For wicked men are found among my people. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.
units.rightText: For among my people are found wicked men: they watch, as fowlers lie in wait; they set a trap, they catch men.

units.leftText: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.
units.rightText: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxed rich.

units.leftText: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excel in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t defend the rights of the needy.
units.rightText: They are waxed fat, they shine: yea, they overpass in deeds of wickedness; they plead not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

units.leftText: “Shouldn’t I punish for these things?” says the LORD. “Shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
units.rightText: Shall I not visit for these things? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

units.leftText: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.
units.rightText: A wonderful and horrible thing is come to pass in the land:

units.leftText: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?
units.rightText: the prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?

units.leftText: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.
units.rightText: Flee for safety, ye children of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth-haccherem; for evil looketh forth from the north, and a great destruction.

units.leftText: I will cut off the beautiful and delicate one, the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: The comely and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, will I cut off.

units.leftText: Shepherds with their flocks will come to her. They will pitch their tents against her all around. They will feed everyone in his place.”
units.rightText: Shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

units.leftText: “Prepare war against her! Arise! Let’s go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
units.rightText: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day declineth, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

units.leftText: Arise! Let’s go up by night, and let’s destroy her palaces.”
units.rightText: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

units.leftText: For the LORD of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.
units.rightText: For thus hath Jehovah of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

units.leftText: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.
units.rightText: As a well casteth forth its waters, so she casteth forth her wickedness: violence and destruction is heard in her; before me continually is sickness and wounds.

units.leftText: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you, lest I make you a desolation, an uninhabited land.”
units.rightText: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from thee; lest I make thee a desolation, a land not inhabited.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn again thy hand as a grape-gatherer into the baskets.

units.leftText: To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, the LORD’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.
units.rightText: To whom shall I speak and testify, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Jehovah is become unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

units.leftText: Therefore I am full of the LORD’s wrath. I am weary with holding it in.
units.rightText: Therefore I am full of the wrath of Jehovah; I am weary with holding in: pour it out upon the children in the street, and upon the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.

units.leftText: Their houses will be turned to others,
units.rightText: And their houses shall be turned unto others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness.
units.rightText: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

units.leftText: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially,
units.rightText: They have healed also the hurt of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

units.leftText: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination?
units.rightText: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall; at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Stand ye in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way; and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls: but they said, We will not walk therein.

units.leftText: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’
units.rightText: And I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet; but they said, We will not hearken.

units.leftText: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.
units.rightText: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.

units.leftText: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.
units.rightText: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

units.leftText: To what purpose does frankincense from Sheba come to me, and the sweet cane from a far country? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices are not pleasing to me.”
units.rightText: To what purpose cometh there to me frankincense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt-offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices pleasing unto me.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together will stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend will perish.”
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will lay stumbling-blocks before this people; and the fathers and the sons together shall stumble against them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.

units.leftText: The LORD says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Behold, a people cometh from the north country; and a great nation shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

units.leftText: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”
units.rightText: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea, and they ride upon horses, every one set in array, as a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Zion.

units.leftText: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
units.rightText: We have heard the report thereof; our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

units.leftText: Don’t go out into the field or walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror are on every side.
units.rightText: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy, and terror, are on every side.

units.leftText: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation, for the destroyer will suddenly come on us.
units.rightText: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation; for the destroyer shall suddenly come upon us.

units.leftText: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
units.rightText: I have made thee a trier and a fortress among my people; that thou mayest know and try their way.

units.leftText: They are all grievous rebels, going around to slander. They are bronze and iron. All of them deal corruptly.
units.rightText: They are all grievous revolters, going about with slanders; they are brass and iron: they all of them deal corruptly.

units.leftText: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.
units.rightText: The bellows blow fiercely; the lead is consumed of the fire: in vain do they go on refining; for the wicked are not plucked away.

units.leftText: Men will call them rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
units.rightText: Refuse silver shall men call them, because Jehovah hath rejected them.

units.leftText: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
units.rightText: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

units.leftText: “Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim this word there, and say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.’”
units.rightText: Stand in the gate of Jehovah’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of Jehovah, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

units.leftText: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, ‘The LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, the LORD’s temple, are these.’
units.rightText: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, are these.

units.leftText: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
units.rightText: For if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

units.leftText: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and don’t walk after other gods to your own hurt,
units.rightText: if ye oppress not the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your own hurt:

units.leftText: then I will cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forever more.
units.rightText: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even for evermore.

units.leftText: Behold, you trust in lying words that can’t profit.
units.rightText: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

units.leftText: Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,
units.rightText: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods that ye have not known,

units.leftText: then come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, ‘We are delivered,’ that you may do all these abominations?
units.rightText: and come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered; that ye may do all these abominations?

units.leftText: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
units.rightText: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

units.leftText: Now, because you have done all these works,” says the LORD, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer;
units.rightText: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith Jehovah, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not:

units.leftText: therefore I will do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.
units.rightText: therefore will I do unto the house which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

units.leftText: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole offspring of Ephraim.
units.rightText: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

units.leftText: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.
units.rightText: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me; for I will not hear thee.

units.leftText: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
units.rightText: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

units.leftText: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
units.rightText: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink-offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

units.leftText: Do they provoke me to anger?” says the LORD. “Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?”
units.rightText: Do they provoke me to anger? saith Jehovah; do they not provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, mine anger and my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Add your burnt-offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat ye flesh.

units.leftText: For I didn’t speak to your fathers or command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices;
units.rightText: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt-offerings or sacrifices:

units.leftText: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
units.rightText: but this thing I commanded them, saying, Hearken unto my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people; and walk ye in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.

units.leftText: But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
units.rightText: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

units.leftText: Since the day that your fathers came out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them.
units.rightText: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day, I have sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

units.leftText: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.
units.rightText: yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff: they did worse than their fathers.

units.leftText: “You shall speak all these words to them, but they will not listen to you. You shall also call to them, but they will not answer you.
units.rightText: And thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

units.leftText: You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to the LORD their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
units.rightText: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the nation that hath not hearkened to the voice of Jehovah their God, nor received instruction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

units.leftText: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
units.rightText: Cut off thy hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Jehovah hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

units.leftText: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says the LORD. “They have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
units.rightText: For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight, saith Jehovah: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

units.leftText: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire, which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.
units.rightText: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded not, neither came it into my mind.

units.leftText: Therefore behold, the days come”, says the LORD, “that it will no more be called ‘Topheth’ or ‘The valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’; for they will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
units.rightText: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that it shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter: for they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place to bury.

units.leftText: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.
units.rightText: And the dead bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten them away.

units.leftText: Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah and from the streets of Jerusalem the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land will become a waste.”
units.rightText: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land shall become a waste.

units.leftText: “At that time,” says the LORD, “they will bring the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of his princes, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves.
units.rightText: At that time, saith Jehovah, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;

units.leftText: They will spread them before the sun, the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, which they have served, after which they have walked, which they have sought, and which they have worshiped. They will not be gathered or be buried. They will be like dung on the surface of the earth.
units.rightText: and they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and which they have sought, and which they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried, they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

units.leftText: Death will be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them,” says the LORD of Armies.
units.rightText: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: “Moreover you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says:
units.rightText: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah: Shall men fall, and not rise up again? Shall one turn away, and not return?

units.leftText: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding?
units.rightText: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

units.leftText: I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right.
units.rightText: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repenteth him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turneth to his course, as a horse that rusheth headlong in the battle.

units.leftText: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times.
units.rightText: Yea, the stork in the heavens knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle-dove and the swallow and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the law of Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘How do you say, “We are wise, and the LORD’s law is with us”?
units.rightText: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of Jehovah is with us? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes hath wrought falsely.

units.leftText: The wise men are disappointed.
units.rightText: The wise men are put to shame, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of Jehovah; and what manner of wisdom is in them?

units.leftText: Therefore I will give their wives to others
units.rightText: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall possess them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

units.leftText: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying,
units.rightText: And they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

units.leftText: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination?
units.rightText: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall; in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘I will utterly consume them, says the LORD.
units.rightText: I will utterly consume them, saith Jehovah: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig-tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

units.leftText: “Why do we sit still?
units.rightText: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there; for Jehovah our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Jehovah.

units.leftText: We looked for peace, but no good came;
units.rightText: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and, behold, dismay!

units.leftText: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan.
units.rightText: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan: at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones the whole land trembleth; for they are come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it; the city and those that dwell therein.

units.leftText: “For, behold, I will send serpents,
units.rightText: For, behold, I will send serpents, adders, among you, which will not be charmed; and they shall bite you, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow!
units.rightText: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! my heart is faint within me.

units.leftText: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off:
units.rightText: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: is not Jehovah in Zion? is not her King in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with foreign vanities?

units.leftText: “The harvest is past.
units.rightText: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

units.leftText: For the hurt of the daughter of my people, I am hurt.
units.rightText: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt: I mourn; dismay hath taken hold on me.

units.leftText: Is there no balm in Gilead?
units.rightText: Is there no balm in Gilead? is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

units.leftText: Oh that my head were waters,
units.rightText: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

units.leftText: Oh that I had in the wilderness
units.rightText: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging-place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

units.leftText: “They bend their tongue,
units.rightText: And they bend their tongue, as it were their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Everyone beware of his neighbor,
units.rightText: Take ye heed every one of his neighbor, and trust ye not in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go about with slanders.

units.leftText: Friends deceive each other,
units.rightText: And they will deceive every one his neighbor, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies; they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

units.leftText: Your habitation is in the middle of deceit.
units.rightText: Thy habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD of Armies says,
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how else should I do, because of the daughter of my people?

units.leftText: Their tongue is a deadly arrow.
units.rightText: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart he layeth wait for him.

units.leftText: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says the LORD.
units.rightText: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith Jehovah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

units.leftText: I will weep and wail for the mountains,
units.rightText: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none passeth through; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the birds of the heavens and the beasts are fled, they are gone.

units.leftText: “I will make Jerusalem heaps,
units.rightText: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling-place of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

units.leftText: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD has spoken, that he may declare it? Why has the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that no one passes through?
units.rightText: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken, that he may declare it? wherefore is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passeth through?

units.leftText: The LORD says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,
units.rightText: And Jehovah saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein,

units.leftText: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.”
units.rightText: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baalim, which their fathers taught them;

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

units.leftText: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known. I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.”
units.rightText: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies says,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for the skilful women, that they may come:

units.leftText: Let them make haste
units.rightText: and let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

units.leftText: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion,
units.rightText: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we ruined! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.

units.leftText: Yet hear the LORD’s word, you women.
units.rightText: Yet hear the word of Jehovah, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbor lamentation.

units.leftText: For death has come up into our windows.
units.rightText: For death is come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.

units.leftText: Speak, “The LORD says,
units.rightText: Speak, Thus saith Jehovah, The dead bodies of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman; and none shall gather them.

units.leftText: The LORD says,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches;

units.leftText: But let him who glories glory in this,
units.rightText: but let him that glorieth glory in this, that he hath understanding, and knoweth me, that I am Jehovah who exerciseth lovingkindness, justice, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that I will punish all those who are circumcised only in their flesh:
units.rightText: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that I will punish all them that are circumcised in their uncircumcision:

units.leftText: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moab, and all who have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness, for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”
units.rightText: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that have the corners of their hair cut off, that dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.

units.leftText: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, house of Israel!
units.rightText: Hear ye the word which Jehovah speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

units.leftText: The LORD says,
units.rightText: thus saith Jehovah, Learn not the way of the nations, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the nations are dismayed at them.

units.leftText: For the customs of the peoples are vanity;
units.rightText: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

units.leftText: They deck it with silver and with gold.
units.rightText: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

units.leftText: They are like a palm tree, of turned work,
units.rightText: They are like a palm-tree, of turned work, and speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither is it in them to do good.

units.leftText: There is no one like you, LORD.
units.rightText: There is none like unto thee, O Jehovah; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

units.leftText: Who shouldn’t fear you,
units.rightText: Who should not fear thee, O King of the nations? for to thee doth it appertain; forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like unto thee.

units.leftText: But they are together brutish and foolish,
units.rightText: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

units.leftText: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish,
units.rightText: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the artificer and of the hands of the goldsmith; blue and purple for their clothing; they are all the work of skilful men.

units.leftText: But the LORD is the true God.
units.rightText: But Jehovah is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembleth, and the nations are not able to abide his indignation.

units.leftText: “You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.’”
units.rightText: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

units.leftText: God has made the earth by his power.
units.rightText: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding hath he stretched out the heavens.

units.leftText: When he utters his voice,
