units.rightText: When he uttereth his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries.

units.leftText: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge.
units.rightText: Every man is become brutish and is without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his graven image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

units.leftText: They are vanity, a work of delusion.
units.rightText: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

units.leftText: The portion of Jacob is not like these;
units.rightText: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Jehovah of hosts is his name.

units.leftText: Gather up your wares out of the land,
units.rightText: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O thou that abidest in the siege.

units.leftText: For the LORD says,
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.

units.leftText: Woe is me because of my injury!
units.rightText: Woe is me because of my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.

units.leftText: My tent has been destroyed,
units.rightText: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth from me, and they are not: there is none to spread my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

units.leftText: For the shepherds have become brutish,
units.rightText: For the shepherds are become brutish, and have not inquired of Jehovah: therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks are scattered.

units.leftText: The voice of news, behold, it comes,
units.rightText: The voice of tidings, behold, it cometh, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling-place of jackals.

units.leftText: LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, I know that the way of man is not in himself; it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

units.leftText: LORD, correct me, but gently;
units.rightText: O Jehovah, correct me, but in measure; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

units.leftText: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you,
units.rightText: Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name; for they have devoured Jacob, yea, they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

units.leftText: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
units.rightText: The word that came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

units.leftText: “Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
units.rightText: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

units.leftText: and say to them, the LORD, the God of Israel says: ‘Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,
units.rightText: and say thou unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: Cursed be the man that heareth not the words of this covenant,

units.leftText: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;
units.rightText: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God;

units.leftText: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.”
units.rightText: that I may establish the oath which I sware unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day. Then answered I, and said, Amen, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

units.leftText: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, “Obey my voice.”
units.rightText: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

units.leftText: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.’”
units.rightText: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the stubbornness of their evil heart: therefore I brought upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they did them not.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: They have turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words. They have gone after other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
units.rightText: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words; and they are gone after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and they shall cry unto me, but I will not hearken unto them.

units.leftText: Then the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem will go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense, but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
units.rightText: Then shall the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem go and cry unto the gods unto which they offer incense: but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

units.leftText: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem you have set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.’
units.rightText: For according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

units.leftText: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up cry or prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.
units.rightText: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me because of their trouble.

units.leftText: What has my beloved to do in my house,
units.rightText: What hath my beloved to do in my house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

units.leftText: The LORD called your name, “A green olive tree,
units.rightText: Jehovah called thy name, A green olive-tree, fair with goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

units.leftText: For the LORD of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done to themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.
units.rightText: For Jehovah of hosts, who planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have wrought for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense unto Baal.

units.leftText: The LORD gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it. Then you showed me their doings.
units.rightText: And Jehovah gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it: then thou showedst me their doings.

units.leftText: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying,
units.rightText: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

units.leftText: But, LORD of Armies, who judges righteously,
units.rightText: But, O Jehovah of hosts, who judgest righteously, who triest the heart and the mind, I shall see thy vengeance on them; for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

units.leftText: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in the LORD’s name, that you not die by our hand’—
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Thou shalt not prophesy in the name of Jehovah, that thou die not by our hand;

units.leftText: therefore the LORD of Armies says, ‘Behold, I will punish them. The young men will die by the sword. Their sons and their daughters will die by famine.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;

units.leftText: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’”
units.rightText: and there shall be no remnant unto them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

units.leftText: You are righteous, LORD,
units.rightText: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, when I contend with thee; yet would I reason the cause with thee: wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they at ease that deal very treacherously?

units.leftText: You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root.
units.rightText: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root; they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

units.leftText: But you, LORD, know me.
units.rightText: But thou, O Jehovah, knowest me; thou seest me, and triest my heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

units.leftText: How long will the land mourn,
units.rightText: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? for the wickedness of them that dwell therein, the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our latter end.

units.leftText: “If you have run with the footmen,
units.rightText: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and though in a land of peace thou art secure, yet how wilt thou do in the pride of the Jordan?

units.leftText: For even your brothers, and the house of your father,
units.rightText: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; even they have cried aloud after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

units.leftText: “I have forsaken my house.
units.rightText: I have forsaken my house, I have cast off my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

units.leftText: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest.
units.rightText: My heritage is become unto me as a lion in the forest: she hath uttered her voice against me; therefore I have hated her.

units.leftText: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey?
units.rightText: Is my heritage unto me as a speckled bird of prey? are the birds of prey against her round about? go ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, bring them to devour.

units.leftText: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard.
units.rightText: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

units.leftText: They have made it a desolation.
units.rightText: They have made it a desolation; it mourneth unto me, being desolate; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.

units.leftText: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness;
units.rightText: Destroyers are come upon all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Jehovah devoureth from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh hath peace.

units.leftText: They have sown wheat,
units.rightText: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns; they have put themselves to pain, and profit nothing: and ye shall be ashamed of your fruits, because of the fierce anger of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD says, “Concerning all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah against all mine evil neighbors, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

units.leftText: It will happen that after I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them. I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them; and I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

units.leftText: It will happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, ‘As the LORD lives;’ even as they taught my people to swear by Baal, then they will be built up in the middle of my people.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, As Jehovah liveth; even as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built up in the midst of my people.

units.leftText: But if they will not hear, then I will pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: But if they will not hear, then will I pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah unto me, Go, and buy thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

units.leftText: So I bought a belt according to the LORD’s word, and put it on my waist.
units.rightText: So I bought a girdle according to the word of Jehovah, and put it upon my loins.

units.leftText: The LORD’s word came to me the second time, saying,
units.rightText: And the word of Jehovah came unto me the second time, saying,

units.leftText: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”
units.rightText: Take the girdle that thou hast bought, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.

units.leftText: So I went and hid it by the Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
units.rightText: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Jehovah commanded me.

units.leftText: After many days, the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
units.rightText: And it came to pass after many days, that Jehovah said unto me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

units.leftText: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.
units.rightText: Then I went to the Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it; and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

units.leftText: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “The LORD says, ‘In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.
units.rightText: This evil people, that refuse to hear my words, that walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is profitable for nothing.

units.leftText: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says the LORD; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’
units.rightText: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith Jehovah; that they may be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

units.leftText: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Every container should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every container should be filled with wine?’
units.rightText: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word: Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

units.leftText: Then tell them, ‘The LORD says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

units.leftText: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says the LORD: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”
units.rightText: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith Jehovah: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have compassion, that I should not destroy them.

units.leftText: Hear, and give ear.
units.rightText: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud; for Jehovah hath spoken.

units.leftText: Give glory to the LORD your God,
units.rightText: Give glory to Jehovah your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

units.leftText: But if you will not hear it,
units.rightText: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because Jehovah’s flock is taken captive.

units.leftText: Say to the king and to the queen mother,
units.rightText: Say thou unto the king and to the queen-mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your headtires are come down, even the crown of your glory.

units.leftText: The cities of the South are shut up,
units.rightText: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is none to open them: Judah is carried away captive, all of it; it is wholly carried away captive.

units.leftText: Lift up your eyes,
units.rightText: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

units.leftText: What will you say when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you?
units.rightText: What wilt thou say, when he shall set over thee as head those whom thou hast thyself taught to be friends to thee? shall not sorrows take hold of thee, as of a woman in travail?

units.leftText: If you say in your heart,
units.rightText: And if thou say in thy heart, Wherefore are these things come upon me? for the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts uncovered, and thy heels suffer violence.

units.leftText: Can the Ethiopian change his skin,
units.rightText: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

units.leftText: “Therefore I will scatter them
units.rightText: Therefore will I scatter them, as the stubble that passeth away, by the wind of the wilderness.

units.leftText: This is your lot,
units.rightText: This is thy lot, the portion measured unto thee from me, saith Jehovah; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

units.leftText: Therefore I will also uncover your skirts on your face,
units.rightText: Therefore will I also uncover thy skirts upon thy face, and thy shame shall appear.

units.leftText: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries
units.rightText: I have seen thine abominations, even thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, on the hills in the field. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! thou wilt not be made clean; how long shall it yet be?

units.leftText: This is the LORD’s word that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.

units.leftText: “Judah mourns,
units.rightText: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish, they sit in black upon the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

units.leftText: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters.
units.rightText: And their nobles send their little ones to the waters: they come to the cisterns, and find no water; they return with their vessels empty; they are put to shame and confounded, and cover their heads.

units.leftText: Because of the ground which is cracked,
units.rightText: Because of the ground which is cracked, for that no rain hath been in the land, the plowmen are put to shame, they cover their heads.

units.leftText: Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young,
units.rightText: Yea, the hind also in the field calveth, and forsaketh her young, because there is no grass.

units.leftText: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights.
units.rightText: And the wild asses stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail, because there is no herbage.

units.leftText: Though our iniquities testify against us,
units.rightText: Though our iniquities testify against us, work thou for thy name’s sake, O Jehovah; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

units.leftText: You hope of Israel,
units.rightText: O thou hope of Israel, the Saviour thereof in the time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a sojourner in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?

units.leftText: Why should you be like a scared man,
units.rightText: Why shouldest thou be as a man affrighted, as a mighty man that cannot save? Yet thou, O Jehovah, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

units.leftText: The LORD says to this people:
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah unto this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore Jehovah doth not accept them; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Don’t pray for this people for their good.
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.

units.leftText: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.”
units.rightText: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt-offering and meal-offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, the prophets tell them, ‘You will not see the sword, neither will you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.’”
units.rightText: Then said I, Ah, Lord Jehovah! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to me, “The prophets prophesy lies in my name. I didn’t send them. I didn’t command them. I didn’t speak to them. They prophesy to you a lying vision, divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.
units.rightText: Then Jehovah said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name; I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake I unto them: they prophesy unto you a lying vision, and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their own heart.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, but I didn’t send them, yet they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ Those prophets will be consumed by sword and famine.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land: By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

units.leftText: The people to whom they prophesy will be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword. They will have no one to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, or their daughters, for I will pour their wickedness on them.
units.rightText: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them—them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

units.leftText: “You shall say this word to them:
units.rightText: And thou shalt say this word unto them, Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

units.leftText: If I go out into the field,
units.rightText: If I go forth into the field, then, behold, the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then, behold, they that are sick with famine! for both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.

units.leftText: Have you utterly rejected Judah?
units.rightText: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul loathed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and, behold, dismay!

units.leftText: We acknowledge, LORD, our wickedness,
units.rightText: We acknowledge, O Jehovah, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against thee.

units.leftText: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake.
units.rightText: Do not abhor us, for thy name’s sake; do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

units.leftText: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain?
units.rightText: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O Jehovah our God? therefore we will wait for thee; for thou hast made all these things.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!
units.rightText: Then said Jehovah unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

units.leftText: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘The LORD says:
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith Jehovah: Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.

units.leftText: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says the LORD: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.
units.rightText: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith Jehovah: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of the heavens, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

units.leftText: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
units.rightText: And I will cause them to be tossed to and fro among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

units.leftText: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem?
units.rightText: For who will have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who will bemoan thee? or who will turn aside to ask of thy welfare?

units.leftText: You have rejected me,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou hast rejected me, saith Jehovah, thou art gone backward: therefore have I stretched out my hand against thee, and destroyed thee; I am weary with repenting.

units.leftText: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land.
units.rightText: And I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land; I have bereaved them of children, I have destroyed my people; they returned not from their ways.

units.leftText: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas.
units.rightText: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas; I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday: I have caused anguish and terrors to fall upon her suddenly.

units.leftText: She who has borne seven languishes.
units.rightText: She that hath borne seven languisheth; she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day; she hath been put to shame and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife,
units.rightText: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them doth curse me.

units.leftText: The LORD said,
units.rightText: Jehovah said, Verily I will strengthen thee for good; verily I will cause the enemy to make supplication unto thee in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

units.leftText: Can one break iron,
units.rightText: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and brass?

units.leftText: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price,
units.rightText: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

units.leftText: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know;
units.rightText: And I will make them to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not; for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.

units.leftText: LORD, you know.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou knowest; remember me, and visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered reproach.

units.leftText: Your words were found,
units.rightText: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy words were unto me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by thy name, O Jehovah, God of hosts.

units.leftText: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice.
units.rightText: I sat not in the assembly of them that make merry, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand; for thou hast filled me with indignation.

units.leftText: Why is my pain perpetual,
units.rightText: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou indeed be unto me as a deceitful brook, as waters that fail?

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says,
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, that thou mayest stand before me; and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: they shall return unto thee, but thou shalt not return unto them.

units.leftText: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall.
units.rightText: And I will make thee unto this people a fortified brazen wall; and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked,
units.rightText: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

units.leftText: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: The word of Jehovah came also unto me, saying,

units.leftText: “You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.”
units.rightText: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters, in this place.

units.leftText: For the LORD says concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land:

units.leftText: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”
units.rightText: They shall die grievous deaths: they shall not be lamented, neither shall they be buried; they shall be as dung upon the face of the ground; and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth.

units.leftText: For the LORD says, “Don’t enter into the house of mourning. Don’t go to lament. Don’t bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people,” says the LORD, “even loving kindness and tender mercies.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament, neither bemoan them; for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith Jehovah, even lovingkindness and tender mercies.

units.leftText: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried. Men won’t lament for them, cut themselves, or make themselves bald for them.
units.rightText: Both great and small shall die in this land; they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them;

units.leftText: Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
units.rightText: neither shall men break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

units.leftText: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”
units.rightText: And thou shalt not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.

units.leftText: For the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

units.leftText: It will happen, when you tell this people all these words, and they ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us?’ or ‘What is our iniquity?’ or ‘What is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt show this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath Jehovah pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Jehovah our God?

units.leftText: then you shall tell them, ‘Because your fathers have forsaken me,’ says the LORD, ‘and have walked after other gods, have served them, have worshiped them, have forsaken me, and have not kept my law.
units.rightText: then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith Jehovah, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

units.leftText: You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me.
units.rightText: and ye have done evil more than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that ye hearken not unto me:

units.leftText: Therefore I will cast you out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
units.rightText: therefore will I cast you forth out of this land into the land that ye have not known, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; for I will show you no favor.

units.leftText: “Therefore behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that it will no more be said, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;’
units.rightText: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that it shall no more be said, As Jehovah liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

units.leftText: but, ‘As the LORD lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them.’ I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.
units.rightText: but, As Jehovah liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries whither he had driven them. And I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

units.leftText: “Behold, I will send for many fishermen,” says the LORD, “and they will fish them up. Afterward I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them from every mountain, from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
units.rightText: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith Jehovah, and they shall fish them up; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

units.leftText: For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from my face. Their iniquity isn’t concealed from my eyes.
units.rightText: For mine eyes are upon all their ways; they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity concealed from mine eyes.

units.leftText: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.”
units.rightText: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled mine inheritance with their abominations.

units.leftText: LORD, my strength, my stronghold,
units.rightText: O Jehovah, my strength, and my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, unto thee shall the nations come from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Our fathers have inherited nought but lies, even vanity and things wherein there is no profit.

units.leftText: Should a man make to himself gods
units.rightText: Shall a man make unto himself gods, which yet are no gods?

units.leftText: “Therefore behold, I will cause them to know,
units.rightText: Therefore, behold, I will cause them to know, this once will I cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Jehovah.

units.leftText: “The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron,
units.rightText: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the tablet of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

units.leftText: Even their children remember their altars
units.rightText: whilst their children remember their altars and their Asherim by the green trees upon the high hills.

units.leftText: My mountain in the field,
units.rightText: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures for a spoil, and thy high places, because of sin, throughout all thy borders.

units.leftText: You, even of yourself, will discontinue from your heritage that I gave you.
units.rightText: And thou, even of thyself, shalt discontinue from thy heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger which shall burn for ever.

units.leftText: The LORD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah: Cursed is the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from Jehovah.

units.leftText: For he will be like a bush in the desert,
units.rightText: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh, but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, a salt land and not inhabited.

units.leftText: “Blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD,
units.rightText: Blessed is the man that trusteth in Jehovah, and whose trust Jehovah is.

units.leftText: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters,
units.rightText: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, that spreadeth out its roots by the river, and shall not fear when heat cometh, but its leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

units.leftText: The heart is deceitful above all things
units.rightText: The heart is deceitful above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who can know it?

units.leftText: “I, the LORD, search the mind.
units.rightText: I, Jehovah, search the mind, I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.

units.leftText: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid,
units.rightText: As the partridge that sitteth on eggs which she hath not laid, so is he that getteth riches, and not by right; in the midst of his days they shall leave him, and at his end he shall be a fool.

units.leftText: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning,
units.rightText: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

units.leftText: LORD, the hope of Israel,
units.rightText: O Jehovah, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be put to shame. They that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Jehovah, the fountain of living waters.

units.leftText: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed.
units.rightText: Heal me, O Jehovah, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

units.leftText: Behold, they ask me,
units.rightText: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of Jehovah? let it come now.

units.leftText: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you.
units.rightText: As for me, I have not hastened from being a shepherd after thee; neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was before thy face.

units.leftText: Don’t be a terror to me.
units.rightText: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my refuge in the day of evil.

units.leftText: Let them be disappointed who persecute me,
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame that persecute me, but let not me be put to shame; let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed; bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

units.leftText: The LORD said this to me: “Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Thus said Jehovah unto me: Go, and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

units.leftText: Tell them, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
units.rightText: and say unto them, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

units.leftText: The LORD says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

units.leftText: Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your fathers.
units.rightText: neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work: but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

units.leftText: But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
units.rightText: But they hearkened not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

units.leftText: It will happen, if you diligently listen to me,” says the LORD, “to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith Jehovah, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but to hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

units.leftText: then there will enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on David’s throne, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city will remain forever.
units.rightText: then shall there enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain for ever.

units.leftText: They will come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, from the lowland, from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, sacrifices, meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving to the LORD’s house.
units.rightText: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places round about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the hill-country, and from the South, bringing burnt-offerings, and sacrifices, and meal-offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving, unto the house of Jehovah.

units.leftText: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem. It will not be quenched.”’”
units.rightText: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

units.leftText: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
units.rightText: The word which came to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

units.leftText: “Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.”
units.rightText: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

units.leftText: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making something on the wheels.
units.rightText: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he was making a work on the wheels.

units.leftText: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
units.rightText: And when the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

units.leftText: Then the LORD’s word came to me, saying,
units.rightText: Then the word of Jehovah came to me, saying,

units.leftText: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says the LORD. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
units.rightText: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith Jehovah. Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are ye in my hand, O house of Israel.

units.leftText: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it,
units.rightText: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;

units.leftText: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turns from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.
units.rightText: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

units.leftText: At the instant I speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it,
units.rightText: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

units.leftText: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they don’t obey my voice, then I will repent of the good with which I said I would benefit them.
units.rightText: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

units.leftText: “Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.”’
units.rightText: Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and amend your ways and your doings.

units.leftText: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”
units.rightText: But they say, It is in vain; for we will walk after our own devices, and we will do every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says:
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Ask ye now among the nations, who hath heard such things; the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

units.leftText: Will the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field?
units.rightText: Shall the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? or shall the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

units.leftText: For my people have forgotten me.
units.rightText: For my people have forgotten me, they have burned incense to false gods; and they have been made to stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths, to walk in bypaths, in a way not cast up;

units.leftText: to make their land an astonishment,
units.rightText: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and shake his head.

units.leftText: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy.
units.rightText: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

units.leftText: Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let’s strike him with the tongue, and let’s not give heed to any of his words.”
units.rightText: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

units.leftText: Give heed to me, LORD,
units.rightText: Give heed to me, O Jehovah, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

units.leftText: Should evil be recompensed for good?
units.rightText: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before thee to speak good for them, to turn away thy wrath from them.

units.leftText: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine,
units.rightText: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword; and let their wives become childless, and widows; and let their men be slain of death, and their young men smitten of the sword in battle.

units.leftText: Let a cry be heard from their houses
units.rightText: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them; for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

units.leftText: Yet, LORD, you know all their counsel against me to kill me.
units.rightText: Yet, Jehovah, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me; forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight; but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thou with them in the time of thine anger.

units.leftText: Thus said the LORD, “Go, and buy a potter’s earthen container, and take some of the elders of the people and of the elders of the priests;
units.rightText: Thus said Jehovah, Go, and buy a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests;

units.leftText: and go out to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I will tell you.
units.rightText: and go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee;

units.leftText: Say, ‘Hear the LORD’s word, kings of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.
units.rightText: and say, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

units.leftText: Because they have forsaken me, and have defiled this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods that they didn’t know—they, their fathers, and the kings of Judah—and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,
units.rightText: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, that they knew not, they and their fathers and the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

units.leftText: and have built the high places of Baal to burn their children in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal, which I didn’t command, nor speak, which didn’t even enter into my mind.
units.rightText: and have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire for burnt-offerings unto Baal; which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:

units.leftText: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says the LORD, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.
units.rightText: therefore, behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, that this place shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter.

units.leftText: “‘“I will make the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem void in this place. I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life. I will give their dead bodies to be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.
units.rightText: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies will I give to be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth.

units.leftText: I will make this city an astonishment and a hissing. Everyone who passes by it will be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.
units.rightText: And I will make this city an astonishment, and a hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

units.leftText: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters. They will each eat the flesh of his friend in the siege and in the distress with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, will distress them.”’
units.rightText: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters; and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend, in the siege and in the distress, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their life, shall distress them.

units.leftText: “Then you shall break the container in the sight of the men who go with you,
units.rightText: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

units.leftText: and shall tell them, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again. They will bury in Topheth until there is no place to bury.
units.rightText: and shalt say unto them, Thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again; and they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place to bury.

units.leftText: This is what I will do to this place,” says the LORD, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.
units.rightText: Thus will I do unto this place, saith Jehovah, and to the inhabitants thereof, even making this city as Topheth:

units.leftText: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.”’”
units.rightText: and the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, shall be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink-offerings unto other gods.

units.leftText: Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house, and said to all the people:
units.rightText: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth, whither Jehovah had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of Jehovah’s house, and said to all the people:

units.leftText: “The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.’”
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.

units.leftText: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the LORD’s house, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
units.rightText: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of Jehovah, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

units.leftText: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the LORD’s house.
units.rightText: Then Pashhur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Jehovah.

units.leftText: On the next day, Pashhur released Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, “The LORD has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.
units.rightText: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashhur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, Jehovah hath not called thy name Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.

units.leftText: For the LORD says, ‘Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes will see it. I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will carry them captive to Babylon, and will kill them with the sword.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

units.leftText: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
units.rightText: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all the gains thereof, and all the precious things thereof, yea, all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies; and they shall make them a prey, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

units.leftText: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house will go into captivity. You will come to Babylon, and there you will die, and there you will be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.’”
units.rightText: And thou, Pashhur, and all that dwell in thy house shall go into captivity; and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and there shalt thou be buried, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied falsely.

units.leftText: LORD, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou hast persuaded me, and I was persuaded; thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am become a laughing-stock all the day, every one mocketh me.

units.leftText: For as often as I speak, I cry out;
units.rightText: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, Violence and destruction! because the word of Jehovah is made a reproach unto me, and a derision, all the day.

units.leftText: If I say that I will not make mention of him,
units.rightText: And if I say, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with forbearing, and I cannot contain.

units.leftText: For I have heard the defaming of many:
units.rightText: For I have heard the defaming of many, terror on every side. Denounce, and we will denounce him, say all my familiar friends, they that watch for my fall; peradventure he will be persuaded, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

units.leftText: But the LORD is with me as an awesome mighty one.
units.rightText: But Jehovah is with me as a mighty one and a terrible: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail; they shall be utterly put to shame, because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which shall never be forgotten.

units.leftText: But the LORD of Armies, who tests the righteous,
units.rightText: But, O Jehovah of hosts, that triest the righteous, that seest the heart and the mind, let me see thy vengeance on them; for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD!
units.rightText: Sing unto Jehovah, praise ye Jehovah; for he hath delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evil-doers.

units.leftText: Cursed is the day in which I was born.
units.rightText: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

units.leftText: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying,
units.rightText: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man-child is born unto thee; making him very glad.

units.leftText: Let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew,
units.rightText: And let that man be as the cities which Jehovah overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime;

units.leftText: because he didn’t kill me from the womb.
units.rightText: because he slew me not from the womb; and so my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

units.leftText: Why did I come out of the womb to see labor and sorrow,
units.rightText: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

units.leftText: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, when King Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,
units.rightText: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

units.leftText: “Please inquire of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us. Perhaps the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may withdraw from us.”
units.rightText: Inquire, I pray thee, of Jehovah for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us: peradventure Jehovah will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

units.leftText: Then Jeremiah said to them, “Tell Zedekiah:
units.rightText: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

units.leftText: ‘The LORD, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the walls; and I will gather them into the middle of this city.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel, Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans that besiege you, without the walls; and I will gather them into the midst of this city.

units.leftText: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.
units.rightText: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation.

units.leftText: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal. They will die of a great pestilence.
units.rightText: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

units.leftText: Afterward,” says the LORD, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’
units.rightText: And afterward, saith Jehovah, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, even such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

units.leftText: “You shall say to this people, ‘The LORD says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
units.rightText: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

units.leftText: He who remains in this city will die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, but he who goes out and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he will live, and he will escape with his life.
units.rightText: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he that goeth out, and passeth over to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

units.leftText: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good,” says the LORD. “It will be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it with fire.”’
units.rightText: For I have set my face upon this city for evil, and not for good, saith Jehovah: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

units.leftText: “Concerning the house of the king of Judah, hear the LORD’s word:
units.rightText: And touching the house of the king of Judah, hear ye the word of Jehovah:

units.leftText: House of David, the LORD says,
units.rightText: O house of David, thus saith Jehovah, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him that is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

units.leftText: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley,
units.rightText: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain, saith Jehovah; you that say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

units.leftText: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings,’ says the LORD;
units.rightText: And I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith Jehovah; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is round about her.

units.leftText: The LORD said, “Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak this word there:
units.rightText: Thus said Jehovah: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

units.leftText: ‘Hear the LORD’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne—you, your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.
units.rightText: and say, Hear the word of Jehovah, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates.

units.leftText: The LORD says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah: Execute ye justice and righteousness, and deliver him that is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence, to the sojourner, the fatherless, nor the widow; neither shed innocent blood in this place.

units.leftText: For if you do this thing indeed, then kings sitting on David’s throne will enter in by the gates of this house, riding in chariots and on horses—they, their servants, and their people.
units.rightText: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

units.leftText: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself,” says the LORD, “that this house will become a desolation.”’”
units.rightText: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith Jehovah, that this house shall become a desolation.

units.leftText: For the LORD says concerning the house of the king of Judah:
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah concerning the house of the king of Judah: Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon; yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.

units.leftText: I will prepare destroyers against you,
units.rightText: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons; and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

units.leftText: “Many nations will pass by this city, and they will each ask his neighbor, ‘Why has the LORD done this to this great city?’
units.rightText: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbor, Wherefore hath Jehovah done thus unto this great city?

units.leftText: Then they will answer, ‘Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD their God, worshiped other gods, and served them.’”
units.rightText: Then they shall answer, Because they forsook the covenant of Jehovah their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

units.leftText: Don’t weep for the dead.
units.rightText: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him; but weep sore for him that goeth away; for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

units.leftText: For the LORD says touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went out of this place: “He won’t return there any more.
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went forth out of this place: He shall not return thither any more;

units.leftText: But he will die in the place where they have led him captive. He will see this land no more.”
units.rightText: but in the place whither they have led him captive, there shall he die, and he shall see this land no more.

units.leftText: “Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness,
units.rightText: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by injustice; that useth his neighbor’s service without wages, and giveth him not his hire;

units.leftText: who says, ‘I will build myself a wide house and spacious rooms,’
units.rightText: that saith, I will build me a wide house and spacious chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is ceiled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

units.leftText: “Should you reign because you strive to excel in cedar?
units.rightText: Shalt thou reign, because thou strivest to excel in cedar? Did not thy father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? then it was well with him.

units.leftText: He judged the cause of the poor and needy;
units.rightText: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Was not this to know me? saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness,
units.rightText: But thine eyes and thy heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for shedding innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD says concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith Jehovah concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! They shall not lament for him, saying Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

units.leftText: He will be buried with the burial of a donkey,
units.rightText: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out.
units.rightText: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all thy lovers are destroyed.

units.leftText: I spoke to you in your prosperity,
units.rightText: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.

units.leftText: The wind will feed all your shepherds,
units.rightText: The wind shall feed all thy shepherds, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

units.leftText: Inhabitant of Lebanon,
units.rightText: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

units.leftText: “As I live,” says the LORD, “though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, I would still pluck you from there.
units.rightText: As I live, saith Jehovah, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;

units.leftText: I would give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
units.rightText: and I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them of whom thou art afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

units.leftText: I will cast you out with your mother who bore you into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.
